raw_text: Major ICS malware incident at Indian chemical plant. PLC malware targeting Siemens S7 controllers with Stuxnet-like capabilities. Safety systems reportedly bypassed. Plant operations suspended pending investigation. CERT-In team on site. This is the most sophisticated OT attack we have seen targeting Indian infrastructure. Sources say the malware was active for weeks before detection.
